Use the object in the picture as the main visual focus, placing it slightly to the left of the frame. The background should be at the junction of a warm white wall and light oak flooring. The right side should have a blank space where a small portion of linen curtain and the soft sunlight casting angled shadows are visible. The overall atmosphere should be tranquil, refreshing, and convey a strong sense of lifestyle. The color scheme of the image should primarily consist of light grey, natural wood, and natural white. The title should be placed in the bottom right corner using a thin-line sans-serif font. The text should read: "Not only storing items, but also preserving order and peace of mind."

Set the object in the image as the main visual focus, placing it centrally in the frame. The background should have a dark blue tone. The desk lamp is turned on, with light gradually diffusing outward, creating a warm orange-yellow halo effect. In front of the lamp base, place a dark wood desk surface with a few pages of an open magazine and a pair of sunglasses scattered on it. The overall style leans towards a vintage modern aesthetic, with strong contrasts in light and shadow. The color scheme creates tension between dark blue and orange. The title should be placed in the upper right corner of the image, with the text: "Illuminating not just the desk, but an attitude."

Focus on the hat as the main visual. Hang the lace sun hat on a white, old wooden door. The brim of the hat should slightly tilt upwards, with the bow hanging naturally. The door should display slight weathering marks, while the background should only retain parts of the door frame and the soft shadows formed by the slanting natural light. The entire composition should be centered, slightly skewed to the right. Use a color palette of off-white, light wood, and sunlit gold. The style should be quiet, natural, with a hint of nostalgia. Place the title in the upper left corner, using a fine, handwritten-style font. The caption should read: "The wind will remember your silhouette."

Design a modern food poster using the given image as the main focus. Keep the pizza clearly showcased in the center of the image, surrounded by floating elements like cheese strings, herb leaves, tomato sauce droplets, and chili slices to create a steaming, freshly-baked atmosphere. Use a bright orange-yellow gradient for the background, paired with soft light and heat wave visual effects to enhance the sense of appetite. Add a prominent, bold title at the top of the image: "Freshly Baked & Spicy". The overall style should be modern and enticing, suitable for promoting a new product at a pizza shop, as a main image on a menu, or for display on an online delivery platform.

Use the object in the image as the main visual focus. Place the red lipstick in the exact center of a deep gray mirrored surface. The background should have the texture of a black velvet curtain. Utilize backlighting to create a focused highlight, allowing the silver tube to reflect a cool luster, with the red lipstick being the sole warm focal point, creating a strong visual center. The mirror reflection should have a slightly soft focus to enhance the texture layers. Do not add any other props to the composition, maintaining a minimalist luxurious style. Position the title in the lower left corner of the image, using uppercase serif font. The text should read: "ONE SWIPE FOCUS." The font color should be matte gold to enhance the balance and sophisticated atmosphere of the image.

Focus on the object of the image as the main visual, place the berry cake at the center of a light pink frosted background, with the cake positioned on a round white porcelain plate. Naturally scatter a few blueberries and strawberry slices around the edge of the plate to enhance the realistic dessert scene; in the background, subtly reveal sugar powder particles and the traces of the handwritten phrase “Happy Sweet Day” to create a light and dreamy atmosphere. The overall color scheme should be primarily pink, white, and berry red, conveying a gentle, soothing style with a visual sweetness. The title is centrally placed at the top of the image, using a curved handwritten font with the text: "Pink is the flavor of today". The font color is berry red to enhance the sweetness and brand recognition.

Position the pink ice cream cone as the primary visual in the center of the image. The background should be a gradient sky blue, with a few hand-drawn candy illustrations and colorful bubble patterns sprinkled around to create a sweet summer vibe. Highlight the creamy texture of the ice cream with high gloss at the top, and let the cone cast a soft shadow at the bottom to enhance the 3D effect. The overall color scheme should focus on pink, blue, yellow, and white, with a bright, playful, and childlike style. Place the title in the upper center of the image, using a bold rounded handwritten font. The text should read: "Sweet to the core, cool into summer!" The font color should be strawberry pink with a light sugary texture effect, echoing the product itself.

Center the ceramic purple clay teapot as the main visual focus, positioning it slightly to the right of the ink wash background. Place the teapot on a coarse ceramic tea tray. The background should consist of a vast area of pale gray and rice paper white for a large blank space, with a faint wisp of tea smoke subtly appearing in the upper right corner. The light should shine diagonally from the upper left to enhance the natural glaze variations and handcrafted textures on the teapot's surface. The overall color tone should primarily feature gray, red, and brown, embodying a serene and subdued style that echoes the "silent beauty" of Oriental objects.

Design a sports-tech style promotional poster using the given image as the main subject. Position the athletic shoes on the left or center of the composition. Use a refreshing gradient background (such as light gray to white, ice blue, or pale orange), and incorporate dynamic lines, speed light effects, and minimal geometric shapes to create a sense of lightness, dynamism, and futurism. The overall style should be simple and modern, suitable for promoting new sports brand products, as the main display of an online store, or for a spring-summer product launch.

Make the object in the image the main visual focus. Place the object vertically in the upper central position of a white velvet background. The ring should be upright with a clear silhouette. A soft shadow ring should be cast below the ring, maintaining a clean, restrained composition to create an extremely pure jewelry display atmosphere. The font color should be a light silver-gray, symbolizing the eternal promise of the diamond.

Use the object in the image as the main visual. Place the chips packaging in the center of the frame. Use the basketball in the image as the main visual element, placing it centrally and slightly above the middle of the frame.
